name: Bǎ zhúmǎ zhuāng jìn bīngxiāng ba!
source:
t's a sweltering summer midnight.

You open the refrigerator, searching through the nearly empty shelves for something to fill your stomach.

That's right, you just want a midnight snack.

So how did it ever come to this?

[From [url=https://sweetsomestudio.itch.io/to-put-your-childhood-sweetheart-into-a-refrigerator]itch.io[/url]]
